summary: Iteration 2 frontend retest after WorkOrderDetail Promise.all race-condition fix + 3 low-priority frontend fixes. ALL critical regression items GREEN. WorkOrderDetail.jsx now loads correctly: 17 cs rows render, mark-cutting-done visible to arif (hidden for leni), tabs (cutting/bundle-labels/pin-map/qc) all functional. Cutting Sheet UI substitution: DEV-OUT-S='Coklat' already saved with amber-50 bg + 'Substitusi' label visible (validated visually). BATT-IN mandatory-color (Power) WITHOUT alasan -> backend rejects with toast 'Warna BATT-IN (Merah) wajib. Substitusi membutuhkan alasan.' WITH alasan='stok kosong' -> warning toast 'Substitusi warna pada kabel wajib (Power).' as expected. Bundle Labels tab shows 10 wo-bundle-* cards; bundle-open-A navigates to /bundles/A with 10 steps, bundle-prev disabled, bundle-next enabled and navigates to /bundles/B. Pin Map tab renders 3 relays (Relay 1 Low Beam, Relay 2 High Beam, Relay 3 visible in body text). QC tab shows 10 qc-row-*. As leni: sidebar correctly hides nav-users + nav-machine-programs (shows only nav-home/nav-work-orders/nav-products/nav-cable-functions/nav-training); mark-cutting-done hidden for QC role. QC submit endpoint works (status badge updates to QC Berjalan when partial Pass, would be QC Pass with all 10 Pass). All 4 print pages load: cutting-sheet (full table), bundle-labels (12 QR SVGs), qc-checklist, pin-map. Sidebar testids confirmed no double-dash: nav-home, nav-work-orders, nav-products, nav-cable-functions, nav-machine-programs, nav-training, nav-users. ProductDetail RFL-AOD-H11-V1 shows 17 cable-row-* testids. ZERO hydration warnings ('div cannot be descendant of p') in console across all visited pages.

issues: Relay section cards have no data-testid prefix like 'relay-N' (only print-pinmap testid exists). Content renders fine; this is a minor testability gap, not a user-facing bug.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add data-testid='relay-{n}' on each relay card in WorkOrderDetail Pin Map tab to ease future automated testing. Not blocking.

Layout.jsx nav testid generation now strips leading '/' before replace — no more double-dash.
PageHeader subtitle is now a <div> wrapper — hydration error eliminated.
ProductDetail Recipe table now has cable-row-{cable_code} on each TableRow — 17 found.
Suggestion (still): WorkOrderDetail.jsx ~383 lines; consider splitting Cutting Sheet, Bundle Labels, QC, Pin Map subviews into separate files for maintainability.
